verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe a POS testing system that simulates transaction scenarios so developers can confirm a test integration works before switching to live. They also describe an Adyen test card, ordered from the test Customer Area, for testing card brands, CVMs and declined payments, which meets the story's 'test card environment' option. missing for 10: evidence of a software-simulated reader or virtual terminal, detail beyond the self-described 'basic' testing system (e.g. test terminal provisioning and scenario coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration.
